value.rationale: Directly resolves an explicit motivated existence question by exhibiting infinite global mean and variance with a finite generating partition and the sharpest possible linear overlap envelope. The different thresholds at exponents 2 and 3, the precise logarithmic boundaries, and the hierarchy at every higher moment establish a structural heavy-tail law rather than an isolated example. The result separates growth of overlap return times from entropy and finite admissibility, with clear relevance to the emerging invariants.
